rationale: Prevotella copri is saccharolytic and amino-acid fermenting. Glucose and arginine are preferred substrates; uptake rates chosen to support ~0.6/h growth (N-limited by available ammonium + arginine N). Fermentation to acetate, propionate, and formate is consistent with known Prevotella metabolism. Carbon balance: 72 mmol C in, 27 for biomass, 45 for products.
